test.description: Diagnose race condition from bug scenario

input.task: Diagnose the root cause of this intermittent connection failure

diagnosis.root_cause: Connection pool is incorrectly shared across multiple threads without proper locking

explanation.symptoms: Intermittent connection errors after 5-6 concurrent requests
explanation.mechanism: Global connection_pool variable is shared across threads, causing race conditions when multiple threads initialize the pool simultaneously

suggested_fix.description: Use thread-local connection pools or proper connection pool locking
suggested_fix.code: from threading import local; thread_local = local(); def get_connection(): if not hasattr(thread_local, 'connection_pool'): thread_local.connection_pool = create_pool(); return thread_local.connection_pool.get()
